Mad.note: Any player the Cerenovus makes mad about a good character.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: Placed on a new choice each night.

full.text: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character: move *MAD* to them. Put the Cerenovus to sleep, wake the target and show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
full.reason: Says last night’s Mad token comes off.
